name: hook
text: Finding a co-founder in Web3 is like hunting in a swamp. DM spam. Polished LinkedIn CVs. All claims — zero receipts.

name: insight
text: But there's one thing you can't fake. Your onchain trail. Every contract you deployed. Every vote you cast. Every commit you merged. Not claims. Evidence.

name: demo-profile
text: Connect a wallet. Five seconds. AI reads three years of your activity and composes your CV. Skills from commit history. Domains from governance votes. A narrative from the real pattern. Not a portfolio you wrote yourself. What the chain actually says about you.

name: demo-swipe
text: Browse verified builders. AI doesn't just match tags. It reads skill complement, domain overlap, values alignment — straight from their governance. Aranea: ZK cryptographer. Skill complement one hundred. Specific rationale, not generic feel. This is math, not chemistry.

name: demo-match
text: Mutual match. Chat unlocks. AI drafts an icebreaker from both profiles. Thirty days of collaboration later, mint a Collaboration NFT on Base Sepolia. Onchain. Soulbound. Portable forever. Reputation that compounds with every collab.

name: vision
text: Not a job board. Not a marketplace. Identity infrastructure for five hundred thousand Web3 builders worldwide. BuilderMatch. Work with proof.
